title: From Hamilton Waitomo Glowworms Blue Springs and Kiwi House
blurb:
Discover the natural beauty of New Zealand on a full-day trip from Hamilton featuring the enchanting Waitomo Glowworm Caves, the Otorohanga Kiwi House, and the stunning Blue Springs. Marvel at the mesmerizing glowworms illuminating the cave ceilings, glide along the underground river, and learn about the unique wildlife at the Kiwi House, home to the famous kiwi bird. Enjoy the serene beauty of the Blue Springs with its crystal-clear waters, making this tour a blend of nature and wildlife that you won't forget. Perfect for nature enthusiasts and small groups, this adventure includes a knowledgeable guide and convenient transport from Hamilton.

- Full-day tour featuring Waitomo Glowworm Caves, Kiwi House, and Blue Springs
- Small group experience limited to 11 participants for personalized attention
- Includes guided 45-minute exploration of the glowworm caves with boat ride
- Complimentary pickup and drop-off from Hamilton, with bottled water and snacks provided
